// s1probe runs S1 experiment 2a end to end: does RemoveUser stop a VLESS
// connection that is already transferring? Everything runs on one host and
// needs nothing installed but an xray binary.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

// Test credentials. Fixed so the two generated configs agree; never reuse.
const (
	uuidA  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	uuidB  = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	tagIn  = "vless-in"
	emailA = "alice@probe"
	emailB = "bob@probe"
)

var (
	xrayBin  = flag.String("xray", "", "path to the xray binary (required)")
	workDir  = flag.String("work", "", "working directory (default: a temp dir)")
	pVless   = flag.Int("port-vless", 10443, "VLESS inbound port")
	pAPI     = flag.Int("port-api", 10085, "xray API port")
	pProxyA  = flag.Int("port-proxy-a", 10801, "HTTP proxy port routed as user A")
	pProxyB  = flag.Int("port-proxy-b", 10802, "HTTP proxy port routed as user B")
	pServe   = flag.Int("port-serve", 18080, "built-in traffic source port")
	before   = flag.Int("before", 10, "seconds of steady flow before removal")
	after    = flag.Int("after", 60, "seconds of observation after removal")
	rateKBps = flag.Int("rate", 512, "per-stream download rate, KiB/s")
)

func main() {
	flag.Parse()
	defer runCleanups()
	trapSignals()
	if *xrayBin == "" {
		fatal("missing -xray: point it at the xray binary")
	}
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(*xrayBin)
	if err != nil || !isFile(abs) {
		fatal("xray binary not found: %s", *xrayBin)
	}
	*xrayBin = abs

	dir := *workDir
	if dir == "" {
		dir, err = os.MkdirTemp("", "s1probe-")
		if err != nil {
			fatal("temp dir: %v", err)
		}
	} else if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
		fatal("workdir: %v", err)
	}

	log := newLogger(filepath.Join(dir, "result.log"))
	defer log.Close()

	log.p("=== S1 experiment 2a: RemoveUser vs a live connection ===")
	log.p("xray      : %s", *xrayBin)
	log.p("version   : %s", firstLine(run(*xrayBin, "version")))
	log.p("workdir   : %s", dir)
	log.p("ports     : vless=%d api=%d proxyA=%d proxyB=%d serve=%d",
		*pVless, *pAPI, *pProxyA, *pProxyB, *pServe)

	for _, p := range []int{*pVless, *pAPI, *pProxyA, *pProxyB, *pServe} {
		if portBusy(p) {
			fatal("port %d is already in use — pick another with the -port-* flags; nothing was started", p)
		}
	}

	stopServe := startTrafficSource(*pServe, log)
	onExit(stopServe)

	if n, err := directFetch(*pServe, 64*1024); err != nil {
		fatal("traffic source is not reachable directly: %v", err)
	} else {
		log.p("self-test: origin served %d bytes over a direct (unproxied) fetch", n)
	}

	writeFile(filepath.Join(dir, "server.json"), serverConfig(dir))
	writeFile(filepath.Join(dir, "client.json"), clientConfig(dir))

	srv := startXray(dir, "server", log)
	onExit(srv.stop)
	cli := startXray(dir, "client", log)
	onExit(cli.stop)

	if err := waitPort(*pAPI, 15*time.Second); err != nil {
		fatal("xray server API never came up: %v (see %s)", err, filepath.Join(dir, "server.log"))
	}
	if err := waitPort(*pProxyA, 15*time.Second); err != nil {
		fatal("xray client proxy never came up: %v (see %s)", err, filepath.Join(dir, "client.log"))
	}
	log.p("both xray processes are up")

	// Sanity: each user must be able to proxy before the experiment means anything.
	for _, u := range []struct {
		name string
		port int
	}{{"A", *pProxyA}, {"B", *pProxyB}} {
		if n, err := fetchN(u.port, 64*1024); err != nil {
			fatal("user %s cannot proxy at all: %v", u.name, err)
		} else {
			log.p("sanity: user %s proxied %d bytes", u.name, n)
		}
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()

	var gotA, gotB atomic.Int64
	go stream(ctx, *pProxyA, &gotA, *rateKBps)
	go stream(ctx, *pProxyB, &gotB, *rateKBps)

	mon := newMonitor(filepath.Join(dir, "monitor.log"))
	defer mon.Close()
	go mon.loop(ctx, *xrayBin, fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", *pAPI), &gotA, &gotB)

	log.p("--- observing %ds of steady flow before removal ---", *before)
	time.Sleep(time.Duration(*before) * time.Second)

	log.p("inbound users BEFORE removal:\n%s", run(*xrayBin, "api", "inbounduser",
		"--server="+fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", *pAPI), "-tag="+tagIn))

	beforeA, beforeB := gotA.Load(), gotB.Load()
	log.p(">>> calling RemoveUser on %s (the same op 3x-ui issues) <<<", emailA)
	out := run(*xrayBin, "api", "rmu", "--server="+fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", *pAPI), "-tag="+tagIn, emailA)
	log.p("rmu output: %s", strings.TrimSpace(out))
	tRemoved := time.Now()

	log.p("inbound users AFTER removal:\n%s", run(*xrayBin, "api", "inbounduser",
		"--server="+fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", *pAPI), "-tag="+tagIn))

	log.p("--- observing %ds after removal ---", *after)
	time.Sleep(time.Duration(*after) * time.Second)

	deltaA := gotA.Load() - beforeA
	deltaB := gotB.Load() - beforeB
	elapsed := time.Since(tRemoved).Seconds()

	log.p("")
	log.p("=== RESULT ===")
	log.p("in the %.0fs after RemoveUser:", elapsed)
	log.p("  user A (REMOVED)     read %d bytes  (%.1f KiB/s)", deltaA, float64(deltaA)/1024/elapsed)
	log.p("  user B (untouched)   read %d bytes  (%.1f KiB/s)", deltaB, float64(deltaB)/1024/elapsed)

	// A stream that only trickled a few KiB was a buffer draining, not a live transfer.
	const alive = 256 * 1024
	switch {
	case deltaA >= alive && deltaB >= alive:
		log.p("VERDICT: A's EXISTING CONNECTION SURVIVED RemoveUser. B unaffected.")
	case deltaA < alive && deltaB >= alive:
		log.p("VERDICT: A's existing connection STOPPED. B unaffected — removal is targeted and effective.")
	case deltaB < alive:
		log.p("VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE — user B also stopped, so something killed both. Check %s.", dir)
	default:
		log.p("VERDICT: unexpected combination; read monitor.log before concluding.")
	}

	// Contrast: removal must at least reject a NEW handshake, or it did nothing.
	if n, err := fetchN(*pProxyA, 64*1024); err != nil {
		log.p("contrast: a NEW connection as removed user A was REJECTED (%v) — as expected", err)
	} else {
		log.p("contrast: a NEW connection as removed user A SUCCEEDED (%d bytes) — removal did not take effect at all", n)
	}

	log.p("")
	log.p("evidence: %s", dir)
	log.p("  result.log   this transcript")
	log.p("  monitor.log  per-second byte deltas (probe-side) and xray's own per-user counters")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- traffic

// startTrafficSource serves an endless stream so a download never finishes on
// its own and end-of-file can never be mistaken for a severed connection.
func startTrafficSource(port int, log *logger) func() {
	srv := &http.Server{Addr: fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port)}
	// A declared length, not an endless chunked stream: an HTTP proxy hop may
	// buffer a response it cannot see the end of. 64 GiB outlasts any run.
	const size = int64(64) << 30
	http.HandleFunc("/stream", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		log.p("ORIGIN got %s %s from %s proto=%s", r.Method, r.URL.Path, r.RemoteAddr, r.Proto)
		buf := make([]byte, 32*1024)
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
		w.Header().Set("Content-Length", fmt.Sprintf("%d", size))
		var sent int64
		for sent < size {
			n, err := w.Write(buf)
			sent += int64(n)
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			select {
			case <-r.Context().Done():
				return
			default:
			}
		}
	})
	go func() {
		if err := srv.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			log.p("traffic source died: %v", err)
		}
	}()
	return func() { _ = srv.Close() }
}

func proxyClient(proxyPort int) *http.Client {
	u, _ := url.Parse(fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d", proxyPort))
	return &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: http.ProxyURL(u)}}
}

func fetchN(proxyPort, n int) (int64, error) {
	c := proxyClient(proxyPort)
	c.Timeout = 15 * time.Second
	resp, err := c.Get(fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d/stream", *pServe))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return io.CopyN(io.Discard, resp.Body, int64(n))
}

// stream keeps one rate-limited download running and counts every byte the
// probe itself receives — a witness independent of xray's own counters.
func stream(ctx context.Context, proxyPort int, counter *atomic.Int64, kbps int) {
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		c := proxyClient(proxyPort)
		req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d/stream", *pServe), nil)
		resp, err := c.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			time.Sleep(time.Second)
			continue
		}
		buf := make([]byte, 8*1024)
		perTick := kbps * 1024 / 10
		read := 0
		tick := time.Now()
		for ctx.Err() == nil {
			n, err := resp.Body.Read(buf)
			if n > 0 {
				counter.Add(int64(n))
				read += n
			}
			if err != nil {
				break
			}
			if read >= perTick {
				if d := 100*time.Millisecond - time.Since(tick); d > 0 {
					time.Sleep(d)
				}
				read, tick = 0, time.Now()
			}
		}
		resp.Body.Close()
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- monitor

type monitor struct{ f *os.File }

func newMonitor(path string) *monitor {
	f, err := os.Create(path)
	if err != nil {
		fatal("monitor log: %v", err)
	}
	return &monitor{f: f}
}

func (m *monitor) Close() { _ = m.f.Close() }

type statResp struct {
	Stat []struct {
		Name  string      `json:"name"`
		Value json.Number `json:"value"`
	} `json:"stat"`
}

func (m *monitor) loop(ctx context.Context, xray, api string, a, b *atomic.Int64) {
	prev := map[string]int64{}
	start := time.Now()
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		stats := map[string]int64{}
		var sr statResp
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(run(xray, "api", "statsquery", "--server="+api, "-pattern", "user>>>")), &sr); err == nil {
			for _, s := range sr.Stat {
				p := strings.Split(s.Name, ">>>")
				if len(p) == 4 {
					v, _ := s.Value.Int64()
					stats[p[1]+"/"+p[3]] = v
				}
			}
		}
		cells := []string{}
		for _, e := range []string{emailA, emailB} {
			for _, d := range []string{"uplink", "downlink"} {
				k := e + "/" + d
				short := strings.SplitN(e, "@", 2)[0] + "." + d[:2]
				if cur, ok := stats[k]; ok {
					cells = append(cells, fmt.Sprintf("%s=+%d", short, cur-prev[k]))
					prev[k] = cur
				} else {
					cells = append(cells, short+"=GONE")
				}
			}
		}
		for _, w := range []struct {
			n string
			c *atomic.Int64
		}{{"probeA", a}, {"probeB", b}} {
			cur := w.c.Load()
			cells = append(cells, fmt.Sprintf("%s=+%d", w.n, cur-prev[w.n]))
			prev[w.n] = cur
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(m.f, "t+%03d  %s\n", int(time.Since(start).Seconds()), strings.Join(cells, "  "))
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
	}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- xray procs

type proc struct {
	cmd *exec.Cmd
	log *os.File
}

func (p *proc) stop() {
	if p.cmd != nil && p.cmd.Process != nil {
		_ = p.cmd.Process.Kill()
		_, _ = p.cmd.Process.Wait()
	}
	if p.log != nil {
		_ = p.log.Close()
	}
}

func startXray(dir, role string, log *logger) *proc {
	lf, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(dir, role+".log"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal("%s log: %v", role, err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(*xrayBin, "run", "-c", filepath.Join(dir, role+".json"))
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = lf, lf
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		fatal("start xray %s: %v", role, err)
	}
	log.p("started xray %s (pid %d)", role, cmd.Process.Pid)
	return &proc{cmd: cmd, log: lf}
}

func serverConfig(dir string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{
  "log": { "loglevel": "debug", "access": %q, "error": %q },
  "api": { "tag": "api", "services": ["HandlerService", "StatsService"] },
  "stats": {},
  "policy": {
    "levels": { "0": { "statsUserUplink": true, "statsUserDownlink": true } },
    "system": { "statsInboundUplink": true, "statsInboundDownlink": true }
  },
  "inbounds": [
    { "tag": "api", "listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d, "protocol": "dokodemo-door",
      "settings": { "address": "127.0.0.1" } },
    { "tag": %q, "listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d, "protocol": "vless",
      "settings": { "clients": [
          { "id": %q, "email": %q, "level": 0 },
          { "id": %q, "email": %q, "level": 0 }
        ], "decryption": "none" },
      "streamSettings": { "network": "tcp" } }
  ],
  "outbounds": [ { "tag": "direct", "protocol": "freedom",
    "settings": { "finalRules": [ { "action": "allow", "ip": ["127.0.0.1/32"] } ] } } ],
  "routing": { "rules": [ { "type": "field", "inboundTag": ["api"], "outboundTag": "api" } ] }
}`, jsonPath(dir, "server-access.log"), jsonPath(dir, "server-error.log"),
		*pAPI, tagIn, *pVless, uuidA, emailA, uuidB, emailB)
}

func clientConfig(dir string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{
  "log": { "loglevel": "warning", "error": %q },
  "inbounds": [
    { "tag": "in-a", "listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d, "protocol": "http" },
    { "tag": "in-b", "listen": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d, "protocol": "http" }
  ],
  "outbounds": [
    { "tag": "out-a", "protocol": "vless", "streamSettings": { "network": "tcp" },
      "settings": { "vnext": [ { "address": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d,
        "users": [ { "id": %q, "encryption": "none", "level": 0 } ] } ] } },
    { "tag": "out-b", "protocol": "vless", "streamSettings": { "network": "tcp" },
      "settings": { "vnext": [ { "address": "127.0.0.1", "port": %d,
        "users": [ { "id": %q, "encryption": "none", "level": 0 } ] } ] } }
  ],
  "routing": { "rules": [
    { "type": "field", "inboundTag": ["in-a"], "outboundTag": "out-a" },
    { "type": "field", "inboundTag": ["in-b"], "outboundTag": "out-b" }
  ] }
}`, jsonPath(dir, "client-error.log"), *pProxyA, *pProxyB, *pVless, uuidA, *pVless, uuidB)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

type logger struct{ f *os.File }

func newLogger(path string) *logger {
	f, err := os.Create(path)
	if err != nil {
		fatal("result log: %v", err)
	}
	return &logger{f: f}
}

func (l *logger) p(format string, a ...any) {
	line := fmt.Sprintf(time.Now().UTC().Format("15:04:05")+"  "+format, a...)
	fmt.Println(line)
	fmt.Fprintln(l.f, line)
}

func (l *logger) Close() { _ = l.f.Close() }

func run(bin string, args ...string) string {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	out, _ := exec.CommandContext(ctx, bin, args...).Output()
	return string(out)
}

func portBusy(p int) bool {
	l, err := net.Listen("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", p))
	if err != nil {
		return true
	}
	_ = l.Close()
	return false
}

func waitPort(p int, d time.Duration) error {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		c, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", p), time.Second)
		if err == nil {
			_ = c.Close()
			return nil
		}
		time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("port %d not listening after %s", p, d)
}

func jsonPath(dir, name string) string { return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(dir, name)) }

func writeFile(path, content string) {
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o600); err != nil {
		fatal("write %s: %v", path, err)
	}
}

func isFile(p string) bool {
	st, err := os.Stat(p)
	return err == nil && !st.IsDir()
}

func firstLine(s string) string {
	if i := strings.IndexAny(s, "\r\n"); i >= 0 {
		return s[:i]
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
}

// Child xray processes must never outlive this probe: it runs on hosts that
// already serve real traffic. os.Exit skips defers, so teardown is explicit.
var cleanups []func()

func onExit(f func()) { cleanups = append(cleanups, f) }

func runCleanups() {
	for i := len(cleanups) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		cleanups[i]()
	}
	cleanups = nil
}

func trapSignals() {
	ch := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(ch, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	go func() {
		s := <-ch
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\ninterrupted (%s) — stopping child processes\n", s)
		runCleanups()
		os.Exit(130)
	}()
}

func fatal(format string, a ...any) {
	runCleanups()
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "ERROR: "+format+"\n", a...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func directFetch(port, n int) (int64, error) {
	c := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	resp, err := c.Get(fmt.Sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d/stream", port))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return io.CopyN(io.Discard, resp.Body, int64(n))
}
